Extensible Markup Language for storing a: Extensible Markup Language for storing and transporting data
Field to add your tag's attributes: Field to add your tag's attributes
Ignore XML tag attributes during parsing: Ignore XML tag attributes during parsing. When unchecked, attributes are included in the output with a "@_" prefix (e.g. id="42" becomes {"@_id": "42"}).
Keep numbers that start with a zero as t: Keep numbers that start with a zero as text so values like ZIP codes, IDs and account numbers are not changed (e.g. "02134" stays "02134" instead of becoming 2134). Other numbers are still converted to numbers.
